details:
This update for hawk2 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-42246: net-imap: MITM attacker can cause Net::IMAP#starttls to return successfully, without starting TLS
  (bsc#1268996).
- CVE-2026-66066: unsafe image processing operations on untrusted uploads can allow arbitrary file reading and remote
  code execution (bsc#1273348).
- CVE-2026-71847: json: heap use-after free in JSON::ResumableParser partial_value can lead to crash on truncated
  duplicate-key streams (bsc#1275213).
- CVE-2026-73490: loofah: improper handling of SVG attributes in the HTML5 sanitizer allows bypass of local-reference
  restrictions (bsc#1275179).
- CVE-2026-73491: loofah: improper handling of javascript: URIs can lead to XSS (bsc#1275183).
- CVE-2026-73492: loofah: improper handling of javascript: and vbscript: URIs can lead to XSS (bsc#1275188).
- CVE-2026-73648: rails-html-sanitizer: cross-site scripting is possible when the sanitizer is configured to allow
  certain SVG reference elements (bsc#1275200).

Changes for hawk2:

- Update to version 2.7.2+git.1788518533.7d4dadd6 (bsc#1275019):
 * Test: give sle15 more time when choosing between sle15 and sle16
 * Dev: bump jQuery version to 4.0.0
 * Dev: bump jQuery version to 3.5.0
 * Dev: bump jQuery version to 2.2.4
 * Test: update the e2e test for the change allowing custom parameters
 * Dev: enable custom Parameters and Meta Attributes (bsc#1274860)
 * CI/CD: update hawk examiner entry point
 * Test: enable test_add_clone against hawk-apiserver verion 0.2.1
 * Test: fix SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\|'
 * Test: make the tests compatible against hawk-apiserver ver0.2.0
